items.name: Rill Browser
items.tagline: The browser where Claude Code and Codex work beside you
items.description: Rill is an AI-native browser built around the Claude Code and Codex you already use. Browse normally, then press ⌘E on any page to turn what you're looking at into a task for your agent. Rill finds the right project, passes along the context, and the agent works while you keep browsing. It also sorts your tabs into themes, turns your history into days you can search, and brings every project your agents are working on into one place. Free, on the plan you already have.

items.name: AUDR by Chargebee
items.tagline: Open standard for tracking agent run costs
items.description: AUDR (Agent Usage Detail Record) is an open standard, for capturing who initiated an agent run and what it cost across every system that run touches. Inspired by the telecom industry's Call Detail Record, AUDR defines a common JSON schema that any harness, router, or billing system can emit and ingest. Three core rules make it work: a shared run ID minted by the harness, clear field ownership, and strict merge rules where conflicts are rejected and corrections are new records.

items.name: OpenBot
items.tagline: Grok Bot alternative: free, local, open-source, multiplayer
items.description: OpenBot is an open-source workspace for AI teammates. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, OpenCode, or custom agents on Mac, Windows, and iOS. Give agents clear roles, let them delegate work, and invite your team to collaborate live with the same agents.

items.name: Incredible
items.tagline: Vibe computing. Control your computer with your voice.
items.description: Incredible is your personal AI assistant that gets work done on your computer. It learns how you work by watching you do it. Show it a task on your computer, talk through the steps, and let it handle the routine from there, from processing invoices and updating your CRM to editing spreadsheets.

items.name: Fuse AI
items.tagline: Build a Custom GTM Stack. One SDK. One MCP.
items.description: Your GTM stack shouldn’t need a dozen tools, subscriptions, and APIs. Fuse gives developers and AI agents one SDK and MCP for the entire workflow. Think OpenRouter x Apollo x Clay x Zapier. Fuse takes care of web automations, data enrichment, multi-channel outreach, workflows, and AI agents. Build unlimited workflows and agents on top, without stitching together separate GTM products for every step.

items.name: Extrovert
items.tagline: Run LinkedIn outreach from your agent
items.description: Extrovert finds prospects, suggests who to comment on or DM today, and prepares drafts in your voice. Review in 20 minutes a day, or hand the whole job to your Claude.

items.name: Willow Knowledge
items.tagline: Your AI already knows you. Now Willow can too.
items.description: Willow Knowledge lets you bring your writing style and personal context into Willow from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or any AI you use. It's like giving superpowers to Willow Scribe. From now on, your email, slack msg, prompt, or wherever you write will sound exactly like you when you dictate.

items.name: Coddy
items.tagline: Learn to code 20+ languages in a fun way with short lessons
items.description: Coddy teaches you to code with short, interactive lessons you actually finish. 20+ languages (Python, JS, C++, SQL, Rust, Go...), a real code editor in the browser with test cases, streaks, weekly leagues and Bugsy - an AI tutor that gives hints, not answers. Everything is free with a daily limit, on web, iOS and Android. 5M+ learners so far. Product Hunt visitors get 50% off any plan for 72h, applied automatically.

items.name: iphone-use
items.tagline: Let AI agents drive a real iPhone, even apps with no API
items.description: iphone-use gives an AI agent a real iPhone: the screen as text, tap, type and scroll over WebDriverAgent, with an honest answer for every action (applied, not sent, or unknown). Payment apps that block screenshots come back as a wireframe. A task done once becomes a flow that replays with no model. HTTP API, a 21-tool MCP server for Claude Code, and remote control from a browser or iOS app. Open source, MIT.

items.name: Ghostifier
items.tagline: Companies have your data. Ghostifier gets them to delete it.
items.description: Instead of one form per company, Ghostifier starts from your inbox. It finds who holds your data, unsubscribes you and opts you out of sale and sharing on day one, waits out the return window, then sends deletion requests and tracks every reply. Banks, insurers and your employer are left alone. It also asks data brokers to delete you. Gmail access is headers only, so it never reads your email bodies, and there is no AI: every decision follows fixed rules.

items.name: NoteWorthy
items.tagline: Notes supercharged with AI, all on-device
items.description: Yet another notes app with AI? Nah. This one is supercharged, and the AI never leaves your device. Jot anything down and NoteWorthy titles it and files it under Tasks, Ideas, Info, Personal or your own labels. One tap turns a messy brain-dump into clean headings and checklists. Long note? Summed up in a line. It all runs on your iPhone, iPad or Mac. Works offline, no account, no subscription, and not a single note sent to a server. Free. ⚡️

items.name: Scumble
items.tagline: The open-source editor for AI inpainting
items.description: Scumble is a free, open-source desktop editor for AI inpainting. Select part of a picture, say what belongs there, and the result lands as its own colour-matched layer. Runs on your own ComfyUI or your own API keys: FLUX 3, GPT Image, Nano Banana and more.

items.name: Chunk
items.tagline: The time-blocking app for macOS
items.description: A time blocking app for Mac that puts your tasks and calendar in one place. Drag a task onto your day and it becomes a block, and a countdown shows how long is left on it. Syncs both ways with Google, Outlook and Apple Calendar, and pulls in Apple Reminders. Save a good day as a template, or ask Claude to plan your week. Your data stays on your Macs and syncs through your own iCloud. No subscription, 7 days free no card required.

items.name: Pheebs
items.tagline: Measure how engineers and teams actually work with AI
items.description: Measure how you and your team actually work with AI coding agents. Pheebs is an open-source AI telemetry tool created by Eversynced. It sits quietly inside Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex via hooks, capturing lightweight interaction signals: the shape of the session, not its contents.

items.name: ruOS
items.tagline: A cloud desktop where AI agents do the work for you
items.description: ruOS is a private cloud desktop with an AI team built in. Ask for research, writing or code and the agents (Claude Code, Codex, ruflo swarms) do it while you watch or step away. Opens in any browser on Mac, iPad or Chromebook, nothing to install. Files and AI memory persist across devices. Power users get a real Linux box plus an MCP server, so ChatGPT or Claude can drive it. Try ruOS Lite free in seconds, no sign-up.

items.name: Cosmic AI Support Agent
items.tagline: An AI support agent that stays in sync with your site
items.description: Put an AI support agent on your website with one script tag. It answers from the content your site already publishes, so when you update a page, the answers update too. Set the name, color, greeting, and a few suggested questions. When the agent can't help, the visitor leaves an email and the question. You get the email. They get a confirmation. Try Leo answering questions about Cosmic, then activate your own: https://www.cosmicjs.com/ai/support-agent

items.name: Doco
items.tagline: Good Company. Music that fits.
items.description: Meet Doco - an expressive Android companion for focus, music and everyday moments, with an optional Windows desktop visitor. Everyday mode is playful and warm; Focus mode cuts the noise with a little friendly sarcasm. Fully animated, zero setup. Connect Spotify and Doco plays music that fits the moment, staying close to your taste with room for something new. Add your own Gemini API key for camera-based reactions and AI captions. Pre-launch - join the waitlist at getdoco.app.

items.name: CodeCrab
items.tagline: 100% local-first AI pull request reviewer
items.description: CodeCrab is a native desktop app that reviews Pull Requests in seconds using your local CLIs. 100% client-side — your code never leaves your machine.

items.name: GeckIt
items.tagline: Kanban board for your Claude Code chats
items.description: Working with several Claude Code chats at once? GeckIt puts them on a Kanban board, so you see which one is working, which one waits for you and which one is done. It runs your own Claude Code on your Claude subscription, no API key. Free and open source, Mac, Windows, Linux.

items.name: Brnch
items.tagline: Modern code hosting for the agent era
items.description: Brnch is code hosting for how we build now: you and your coding agents in the same repo. It's Git underneath (for now), so your tools still work. Each agent gets its own identity and works under you as its sponsor, so you can see exactly what it did, down to the line. Every merge is tested on the exact result that lands, not just the branch, and comes with a signed receipt anyone can verify. To start, tell your agent: "Set me up on Brnch: brnch.io"
